layout.text: BRANCH ASSIST  /  LEADERSHIP BRIEF  /  SOLUTION OVERVIEW

Generative AI for grounded
procedure guidance.
Conversational access to eleven operational procedures, with traceable answers and contextual follow-ups.
Help branch employees find and verify applicable guidance across long, conditional procedures.
Retrieve supporting passages, generate a concise answer, then check each claim against its cited source.
Answers from procedure evidence with source citations.
Retain the situation and retrieve fresh evidence.
Original text, answer checks and execution activity.
Value to measure: accurate, relevant, complete and concise guidance with less search effort.
Implementation scope: provided Cayman Bank procedures · local model inference · source citations and reviewable check records
BRANCH ASSIST  /  LEADERSHIP BRIEF  /  DOCUMENT ENGINEERING

From original documents
to structured, searchable evidence.
Preserve content, conditions and source identity throughout ingestion, chunking and indexing.

11 HTML files; 79,424
extracted words; 139 tables.
Capture titles, IDs and
publication details.

UTF-8 headings, lists and
table rows. Preserve column
labels, row conditions and
nested content.

~110 narrative words;
20-word overlap. Repeat
table conditions on
continuation passages.

1,388 passages; BM25 +
384D dense vectors. Record
source, section and
original-file hash.
Focused passages improve retrieval; repeated conditions protect applicability. Source fingerprints and index checks detect changed inputs.
Narrative chunk size is a word target · table rows preserve their labels and conditions · original source bytes remain unchanged
BRANCH ASSIST  /  LEADERSHIP BRIEF  /  BUILD THE ANSWER

Retrieve the rule. Generate an answer.
Check the claims before release.
A small local pipeline makes evidence, control decisions and failure outcomes inspectable.
PREPARED OFFLINE   Verified passages + keyword statistics + normalized vectors
Weak evidence → clarify or report insufficient support.
Failed checks → one revision → withhold if still failing.
Replaceable source material and explicit citations.
Exact identifiers plus paraphrases; jointly rerank.
Local CPU, no API key; small in-memory index.
MiniLM-L6 embeddings and reranking · DeBERTa NLI support screening · source identity and claim-local citations
BRANCH ASSIST  /  LEADERSHIP BRIEF  /  EXPERIENCE AND FOLLOW-UPS

Context, citations and review
in one conversational workflow.
A follow-up retains the user’s situation while retrieving new supporting evidence.
Procedure library and guided starters; selected documents restrict retrieval.
Retain the situation. A new topic changes scope; every turn retrieves evidence.
Open citations, checks and activity; flag a response and export the investigation.
What is the overnight storage limit for a coin-counting machine?
The overnight storage limit for a coin-counting machine is $5,250 [S1].
And is monthly testing done in single or dual control?
Monthly testing is done in single control. [S2]
S1: overnight storage → S2: monthly testing
Every turn retrieves evidence · prior generated answers are not source material · scope, reset, session isolation, feedback and export are supported
BRANCH ASSIST  /  LEADERSHIP BRIEF  /  MEASURE THE EVIDENCE

Evaluate retrieval and response quality
as separate measures.
Measured local regression results; independent review is still required for an operational decision.
Phrase matching can miss valid wording or pass an incorrect answer.
WHAT TO MEASURE / WHAT A REVIEWER MUST JUDGE
Is every instruction correct for this situation?
Does it answer the exact question?
Are material conditions and exceptions included?
Is it brief without losing necessary guidance?
Next: two independent reviewers, unseen scenarios, critical-error checks.
30 procedure questions + 4 two-turn conversations + 6 selected guardrails · AI-authored/source-checked labels · cold load excluded · draft length n=32

Demonstrate answers, follow-ups
and evidence review.
Show the functional chat with procedure questions, changed conditions and a clear review path.

Newer account → Private Bank Experience exception.
